headline: Spotify Experiences Second Major Outage in One Day, Affecting Web and Apps
summary: The music streaming giant is grappling with a new wave of technical issues, leaving users unable to access its services for the second time today.
details: Spotify is currently experiencing a significant outage, impacting both its web page and mobile applications. Users have reported widespread issues, with many unable to stream music or access their accounts.

This marks the second major disruption for the music streaming service today. An earlier outage in the morning was reportedly resolved, but new problems emerged around 3 PM ET, affecting a new batch of users.

The official Spotify Status account on X acknowledged the ongoing issues, stating, "We're aware of some issues right now with our web page and are checking them out!" The company has not yet provided an estimated time for resolution.
Reports on Downdetector indicate a surge in user complaints, highlighting the extent of the service disruption. The company is working to restore full functionality as quickly as possible.
